reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) demonstrates that annealing can induce SRO in HEAs (CoFeNi and NbTaTi) and that this affects mechanical properties, but it provides no support for the premises linking SRO to electronic structure, electron–phonon coupling, or superconductivity. The key mechanistic claims are entirely unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Annealing a Ti-rich HEA can induce short-range chemical order (SRO).
SRO modifies the local electronic density of states at the Fermi level.
Modified local density of states enhances electron–phonon coupling.
Enhanced electron–phonon coupling increases the superconducting Tc.
